steps.domain_action: Ayin precedes the emergence of the first point.
Keter establishes the self-referential identity of the divine will.
The light descends from the crown toward the intellectual faculties.
Da'at synthesizes the hidden knowledge to prepare for emotive branching.
The singular flow divides into the dual pillars of the tree.
The right arm extends as Chesed to provide infinite mercy.
Mercy flows forward to sustain the existence of the other.
The left arm extends as Gevurah to provide necessary constraint.
Severity pulls back to define the boundaries of the individual.
The system holds the tension between total expansion and total contraction.
Tiferet integrates the opposing forces into a balanced central column.
The resulting harmony is recorded as a permanent structural law in the Reshimu.
Malkuth seals the operation within the physical manifestation.
